minutes.headline: Board adopted a tax title policy and approved a new three-year Town Manager contract; Paula Bertram honored on leaving.
minutes.summary: The meeting opened with tributes to departing selectman Paula Bertram, including state citations and public comments. The treasurer gave the third-quarter financial report, and the board approved a new Town Manager contract.

what_happened.line: The Select Board approved a new three-year Town Manager contract, aligned with the fiscal year, with the salary set.
The board moved to adopt a tax title policy, changed so selectmen or the town manager decide action on foreclosed property; the result was not audible.
The treasurer's third-quarter report showed local receipts at or above estimates and covered a snow removal deficit and legal costs by supplemental appropriation.
The Town Manager is to schedule a joint Finance Committee and Selectmen meeting on police and fire staffing and paramedic service; a goal-setting workshop is set for June 12th.
The meeting opened with tributes to departing selectman Paula Bertram; the board also approved a skate park tollbooth and signed a corrected liquor license.

why_it_matters: The Town Manager contract fixes who runs town operations, and what that costs, for three fiscal years.
The tax title policy sets how the town handles properties with unpaid taxes, including whether foreclosed land is kept or sold, and it is to be reviewed next year.
Snow removal and legal costs were covered by supplemental appropriations, which draw on town funds, mostly taxes, and the planned staffing meeting could shape future public safety budgets.
watch_next: Joint Finance Committee and Selectmen meeting on police, fire and paramedic staffing, to be scheduled by the Town Manager.
Goal-setting workshop on June 12th, and the election on Saturday for the vacant board seat.
